desc: Define the four diagonal direction vectors with clockwise-turn mapping.
Precompute alternating suffix lengths for each diagonal direction and each required starting value (`0` or `2`).
Combine every valid first leg beginning at `1` with its clockwise turned suffix using correct parity and without double-counting the corner.
Include no-turn segments and standalone `1` cells, then implement `Solution.lenOfVDiagonal`.
Validate against all examples and relevant boundary/parity edge cases.
